Humidity, contamination and hazard, controlled together
IAQ company profile
Battery manufacturing involves hazardous materials and processes, and each one is controlled by design.

Moisture control, cleanliness, contamination control and the explosion proof requirement are one design task rather than four. The envelope, the airlocks, the dehumidification plant and the safety systems are designed as a single package.

One accountable team, every system

A moisture-controlled environment, cleanliness standards, contamination control and explosion proofing are essential to making EV batteries safely.

IAQ builds facilities tailored to the requirements of EV battery manufacturing. Our focus is precision engineering and sustainability: the infrastructure behind clean energy.

A dry room performs to the standard of its envelope and its dehumidification plant, so design and commissioning carry the outcome on every battery project.

A gigafactory dry room
Representation
Dry room, not cleanroom

Battery lines are specified as dry rooms rather than ISO cleanrooms on most delivered projects, with one recorded project at ISO 7, Class 10K. The explosion proof requirement sits alongside the humidity target rather than after it, so the envelope, the airlocks and the safety systems are designed as one package.
